def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i]))==1]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    rb=[i for i in range(h) if i not in sep_rows]
    cb=[j for j in range(w) if j not in sep_cols]
    # group into contiguous runs
    def runs(idx):
        out=[];cur=[idx[0]]
        for x in idx[1:]:
            if x==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(x)
            else: out.append(cur);cur=[x]
        out.append(cur);return out
    R,C=runs(rb),runs(cb)
    from collections import Counter
    out=[]
    for rws in R:
        orow=[]
        for cls in C:
            cnt=Counter(g[i][j] for i in rws for j in cls)
            maj=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
            minor=sum(v for k,v in cnt.items() if k!=maj)
            orow.append(maj if minor==1 else 1)
        out.append(orow)
    return out
